description: Find MEPs by name, person ID, country, political group, gender, term or mandate date. Without term or mandate_date, members in office today; term selects that term's roster, mandate_date the members seated that day. Name matching needs every token, after case, diacritic and punctuation normalization, over the whole roster before paging. mep_ids takes the person IDs other tools return (voter mep_id, participant person_ids, question creator person/ references) in one call; IDs not in the roster come back in unmatched_mep_ids. Country and group are as published for the selected roster, never inferred for another date; term rosters publish neither. Continue with page.next_offset and snapshot; after snapshot_changed, restart at offset 0 without it. euparl_get_mep reads identity and membership history.

country.description: ISO alpha-2 code, any case. United Kingdom members are published as GB (UK accepted), on historical rosters only. See euparl_list_reference topic mep_filters.

gender.description: Gender code FEMALE, MALE, NAP, NKN or NST, any case.

language.description: EU ISO 639-1 language, any case; default en; text is never translated.

limit.description: Items per page; default 20. Local collections return every requested row, with no output-size cap.

mandate_date.description: Members seated on this YYYY-MM-DD date, not after today (UTC); exclusive with term. Country and group match as published that day. A term's first sitting day can return an incomplete roster or an upstream error; use the next day.

mep_ids.description: Person IDs to keep, as other tools return them: voter mep_id, participant person_ids, question creator person/ references. Canonicalized and deduplicated; an empty list counts as omitted; an org/ or other non-person entry is rejected. Narrows with every other filter, no extra request. Pick the roster the IDs belong to: mandate_date (the vote or sitting date) for country and group as published that day, term for names only.

name_contains.description: Every token must match, over the whole roster; case, diacritics and punctuation normalized, no fuzzy scoring. Needs a letter or digit.

political_group.description: Group code, current or historical (PPE, S-D, PPE-DE, GUE-NGL…), or published label (S&D, Verts/ALE, The Left), any case; EPP, Greens/EFA and Patriots also work. euparl_list_reference topic mep_filters lists codes, labels and periods. GUE/NGL is GUE-NGL on terms 0–8 and through 2020-12-18, else THE-LEFT. Current and mandate_date rosters match the code in force that day; a term roster matches memberships not ended when the term began, not who sat in the group during the term (use mandate_date).

snapshot.description: Returned roster snapshot; required above offset 0.

term.description: Term 0–10, exclusive with mandate_date; omit both for members in office today.

name: euparl_search_meps

available.description: Whether the source array was published; a published empty array counts.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_filter`: A code, term or language is unsupported; a mep_ids entry is not a person ID; name_contains has no letter or digit; or mandate_date is not a real date or is after today (UTC). `invalid_mode_fields`: A nonzero offset lacks a snapshot, or mandate_date is combined with term. `snapshot_changed`: The roster changed since the supplied snapshot. `upstream_paging_stalled`: A roster read came back incomplete. `upstream_rejected`: Parliament rejects the validated request. `upstream_rate_limited`: Parliament rate limiting outlasts the retries. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

country.description: Published country in this roster; can be absent on historical rosters.

political_group.description: Published political group in this roster; never inferred for a vote date.

notice.description: Publication, language fallback, empty-result or continuation guidance.

has_more.description: True when more matches exist or cannot be ruled out.

limit.description: Effective page size after caps and the search window.

next_offset.description: Offset of the next page; absent at the search-window boundary even when has_more is true.

snapshot.description: Pass back with next_offset to continue this local collection.

totalCount.description: Exact total; only when published or counted over the whole collection.

truncated.description: True when this page holds only part of the collection.

unmatched_mep_ids.description: Requested mep_ids with no row in the selected roster after every filter, in first-seen order, the same on every page; only when mep_ids was supplied. A wrong term or date is the usual cause; euparl_get_mep reads any member by ID.

title: Find members of the European Parliament
